prompts.battle-ui: Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver a polished static desktop UI design, wide landscape 1920x1200 composition, for a premium historical Chinese strategy card battler named 御前军阵. Complete art-directed game UI screenshot, not wireframe. Rich restrained ink jade battlefield, subtle bronze and parchment, cinematic painterly ancient Chinese soldiers in RECTANGULAR portrait cards. NO ovals, NO huge golden or icy frames, NO large circular glows, NO leaves or chunky texture obstructing the card, NO Hearthstone logos. Highest priority: simultaneous multi-status clarity. Two opponents with 4 rectangular units in each row, top enemy commander and bottom friendly commander, tidy bottom hand of 5 cards, round control at right, two small secret seals and one tiny weapon slot near commander, a camp landmark in one field slot. Every on-field card has its unchanged rectangular illustration and clean numeric attack / health footer. Below EACH unit is a separate, precisely aligned compact rectangular status dock: one jade-positive row and one muted-purple-negative row, each composed of individual 32px wide enamel insignia badges with distinct readable symbolic icons and numeric deltas; no full-card status overlays. Different effects remain simultaneously visible. One selected card has 8 badges in three rows including attack +4, max health +3, shield, temporary attack +2, frozen snowflake, silence crossed-bell, weakness −2, granted guard. Other cards show different combinations of 1, 3, 5 effects. No '+N more' overflow indicator; all badges visible. Unchanged portrait faces unobstructed, each status dock stays inside its own unit column. At RIGHT of the battlefield, a 300px inspector panel outside the card grid shows selected unit name and clean sections 增益 负面 属性, each effect as a distinct list row with its own original tiny insignia, Chinese name, signed number or condition, source and expiry in subdued secondary text. Show +4 attack and −2 attack separately, bottom arithmetic attack base3 +4 +2 −2 =7. Hero armor and weapon durability distinct from troop health. Clear hierarchy, whitespace, restrained material highlights, quiet matte permanent states. The game title at top left 御前军阵 and small label UI 设计稿. Visual direction is tactile ancient military command tokens and refined carved metal, not glossy mobile pay-to-win border overload. This is a complete professional game UI presentation, all text crisp Simplified Chinese, real credible spacing. No browser chrome, no decorative explanatory paragraphs.
